content.title: MFF Fan Events
content.text: Game On, Indy! The 2026 NCAA Men's Final Four is coming to Indianapolis April 2-6 with tons of FREE and low-cost Fan Events you won't want to miss! Learn more about the Official NCAA Fan Events below and use the Quick Links to get all the info you need to know. Click here for the 2026 Men's Final Four Security Policies Click here for the 2026 Official Men's Final Four Event Map Men's Final Four Fan Fest presented by Capital One Friday, April 3 - Monday, April 6 Indiana Convention Center 100 S. Capitol Ave, Indianapolis, IN Tip-off your weekend with a trip to the Men's Final Four Fan Fest presented by Capital One. As you take your first steps through the doors, you’ll be greeted by a sports wonderland of interactive games, special celebrity and athlete appearances, autograph signings, and much more! Experience the thrill of the Men's Final Four like never before! Click Here for Ticket & Event Information | Purchase tickets HERE Have an Unlock Code? Click HERE to learn how to redeem. March Madness Music Festival Friday, April 3 - Sunday, April 5 American Legion Mall 700 N. Pennsylvania Street, Indianapolis, IN Enjoy three days of electrifying music—completely FREE—featuring unforgettable performances by A-list artists, all set during the most exciting weekend in college sports. Get ready for a music celebration like no other! The concert series kicks off on Friday afternoon with the AT&T Block Party and continues through the night. Saturday brings the energy of Coca-Cola Live, followed by the grand finale on Sunday with the Capital One Jam Fest. Reese's Final Four Friday Friday, April 3 Lucas Oil Stadium 500 S. Capitol Ave. Indianapolis, IN Packed with interactive activities and entertainment suitable for fans of all ages, this FREE public event offers a unique experience. It features open team practices for the Men's Final Four teams and showcases the Reese's NABC All-Star Game, featuring top senior student-athletes from across the nation competing on the very court where the Men's Final Four Semifinal and Championship games will take place. Don't miss this incredible chance to get up close with the teams and players and soak in the atmosphere of the venue! Men's Final Four Tip-Off Tailgate Friday, April 3 - Monday, April 6 Georgia Street 126 E Georgia St, Indianapolis, IN 46225 Calling all Men's and Women's Basketball Fans! Whether you're heading to the games at Lucas Oil Stadium or exploring all the excitement of the Final Four around the city, make sure to stop by the Men’s Final Four Tip-Off Tailgate. Enjoy FREE watch parties for BOTH the Men’s and Women’s Final Four games, plus a variety of fun for the whole family—including giveaways, basketball-themed activities, and a selection of food and drinks. Men's Final Four Dribble presented by GEICO The 2026 Event Has Reached Capacity Sunday, April 5 Carroll Stadium (Registration & Start Line) 1001 W. New York St. Indianapolis, IN 46202 Victory Field (Finish Line) 501 W. Maryland St. Indianapolis, IN 46225 Join us at the Dribble, where thousands of young participants, aged 18 and under, will dribble their way through a one-mile course. Each child will show off their dribbling skills with their very own exclusive NCAA Men's Final Four Dribble Wilson basketball, accompanied by a specially designed branded t-shirt. The course winds its way through the vibrant streets of downtown Indianapolis! Joint Championship NCAA Division II & Division III Men's Basketball Championships Sunday, April 5 Gainbridge Fieldhouse Division II Men's Basketball National Championship | Time: 1:00 p.m. ET Division III Men's Basketball National Championship | Time: 4:30 p.m. ET National Invitation Tournament (NIT) Thursday, April 2 | Hinkle Fieldhouse Game 1: 7:00 p.m. ET Game 2: 9:30 p.m. ET Sunday, April 5 | Gainbridge Fieldhouse | Time: 8:00 p.m. ET
